2cffcb5d04b0a8b7.sql: -- R1: supplier incorporated less than 6 months (183 days) before the award date. -- Joins awards -> supplier_xwalk (Resolver) -> ACRA entities. Params: 'Housing and Development Board' '2024-04-01' '2025-03-31' SELECT 'R1' AS flag_id, a.tender_no, a.agency, a.supplier_name, e.uen, a.award_date, a.awarded_amt, 'incorporation_age_days' AS metric_name, datediff(a.award_date, e.registration_incorporation_date) AS metric_value, '183' AS threshold, concat('Anomaly for review: ', e.entity_name, ' (', e.entity_type_description, ', ', e.entity_status_description, ') was incorporated ', CAST(e.registration_incorporation_date AS STRING), ', ', CAST(datediff(a.award_date, e.registration_incorporation_date) AS STRING), ' days before the award on ', CAST(a.award_date AS STRING), '. Resolver match: ', x.method, ' (confidence ', CAST(x.confidence AS STRING), ').') AS detail FROM gebiz_pg.awards a JOIN gebiz_pg.supplier_xwalk x ON x.supplier_name = a.supplier_name AND x.uen IS NOT NULL JOIN ACRA_FILES.entities e ON e.uen = x.uen WHERE a.agency = 'Housing and Development Board' AND a.award_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2025-03-31' AND datediff(a.award_date, e.registration_incorporation_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 183 ORDER BY metric_value ASC, a.awarded_amt DESC

75f82435f0676ef9.sql: -- R2: supplier's ACRA status is not live (struck off, ceased, in liquidation, dissolved, cancelled, terminated...). -- Status is the CURRENT registry status, not the status at award time. Params: 'Housing and Development Board' '2024-04-01' '2025-03-31' SELECT 'R2' AS flag_id, a.tender_no, a.agency, a.supplier_name, e.uen, a.award_date, a.awarded_amt, 'acra_status' AS metric_name, e.entity_status_description AS metric_value, 'Live' AS threshold, concat('Anomaly for review: ', e.entity_name, ' (', e.entity_type_description, ') has current ACRA status "', e.entity_status_description, '"; awarded ', CAST(a.award_date AS STRING), '. ACRA publishes the current status only, so the entity may have been live at award time.') AS detail FROM gebiz_pg.awards a JOIN gebiz_pg.supplier_xwalk x ON x.supplier_name = a.supplier_name AND x.uen IS NOT NULL JOIN ACRA_FILES.entities e ON e.uen = x.uen WHERE a.agency = 'Housing and Development Board' AND a.award_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2025-03-31' AND upper(e.entity_status_description) RLIKE 'STRUCK OFF|CEASED|LIQUIDATION|WINDING UP|DISSOLVED|CANCELLED|TERMINATED|REMOVED|EXPIRED' ORDER BY a.awarded_amt DESC

90341f83d0082a53.sql: -- R3: two or more DISTINCT winning suppliers (different UENs) at the same agency share an exact registered address -- (postal code + block + street + level + unit). One row per award by a supplier in the group. -- Sole proprietorships/partnerships are excluded: their unit-level address is not published in the committed sample. -- Params: 'Housing and Development Board' '2024-04-01' '2025-03-31' WITH won AS ( SELECT DISTINCT a.agency, x.uen FROM gebiz_pg.awards a JOIN gebiz_pg.supplier_xwalk x ON x.supplier_name = a.supplier_name AND x.uen IS NOT NULL WHERE a.agency = 'Housing and Development Board' AND a.award_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2025-03-31' ), addr AS ( SELECT w.agency, w.uen, concat_ws('|', e.postal_code, upper(e.block), upper(e.street_name), upper(e.level_no), upper(e.unit_no)) AS addr_key, concat_ws(' ', e.block, e.street_name, concat('#', e.level_no, '-', e.unit_no), concat('S', e.postal_code)) AS addr_text FROM won w JOIN ACRA_FILES.entities e ON e.uen = w.uen WHERE e.entity_type_description <> 'Sole Proprietorship/ Partnership' AND e.postal_code IS NOT NULL AND length(e.postal_code) = 6 AND e.street_name IS NOT NULL AND upper(e.street_name) <> 'NA' ), grp AS ( SELECT agency, addr_key, count(DISTINCT uen) AS n_suppliers, min(addr_text) AS addr_text FROM addr GROUP BY agency, addr_key HAVING count(DISTINCT uen) >= 2 ) SELECT 'R3' AS flag_id, a.tender_no, a.agency, a.supplier_name, x.uen, a.award_date, a.awarded_amt, 'suppliers_at_address' AS metric_name, g.n_suppliers AS metric_value, '2' AS threshold, concat('Anomaly for review: ', CAST(g.n_suppliers AS STRING), ' distinct winning suppliers at this agency share the ACRA address ', g.addr_text, '. Shared business centres can explain this; requires auditor judgement.') AS detail FROM gebiz_pg.awards a JOIN gebiz_pg.supplier_xwalk x ON x.supplier_name = a.supplier_name AND x.uen IS NOT NULL JOIN addr d ON d.uen = x.uen AND d.agency = a.agency JOIN grp g ON g.agency = d.agency AND g.addr_key = d.addr_key WHERE a.agency = 'Housing and Development Board' AND a.award_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2025-03-31' ORDER BY g.n_suppliers DESC, g.addr_text, a.award_date

49e007f90b12b5ef.sql: -- R4: possible contract splitting. Same agency and supplier: >= 2 awards, each below S$90,000, within a 90-day -- window, together above S$90,000. One row per award that sits in at least one qualifying window. -- GeBIZ data here has tender (ETT) awards only, so splitting below the quotation band is under-detected. -- Params: 'Housing and Development Board' '2024-04-01' '2025-03-31' WITH s AS ( SELECT tender_no, agency, supplier_name, award_date, awarded_amt FROM gebiz_pg.awards WHERE agency = 'Housing and Development Board' AND award_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2025-03-31' AND awarded_amt > 0 AND awarded_amt < 90000 ), win AS ( SELECT s1.agency, s1.supplier_name, s1.award_date AS win_start, count(DISTINCT s2.tender_no) AS n_awards, sum(s2.awarded_amt) AS total_amt FROM s s1 JOIN s s2 ON s1.agency = s2.agency AND s1.supplier_name = s2.supplier_name AND s2.award_date BETWEEN s1.award_date AND date_add(s1.award_date, 90) GROUP BY s1.agency, s1.supplier_name, s1.award_date HAVING count(DISTINCT s2.tender_no) >= 2 AND sum(s2.awarded_amt) > 90000 ) SELECT 'R4' AS flag_id, m.tender_no, m.agency, m.supplier_name, max(x.uen) AS uen, m.award_date, m.awarded_amt, 'window_total_sgd' AS metric_name, max(w.total_amt) AS metric_value, '90000' AS threshold, concat('Anomaly for review: ', CAST(max(w.n_awards) AS STRING), ' sub-S$90k awards to this supplier within 90 days total S$', CAST(round(max(w.total_amt), 2) AS STRING), ' (window starting ', CAST(min(w.win_start) AS STRING), '), above the S$90k tender threshold. May indicate splitting; requires auditor judgement.') AS detail FROM s m JOIN win w ON w.agency = m.agency AND w.supplier_name = m.supplier_name AND m.award_date BETWEEN w.win_start AND date_add(w.win_start, 90) LEFT JOIN gebiz_pg.supplier_xwalk x ON x.supplier_name = m.supplier_name GROUP BY m.tender_no, m.agency, m.supplier_name, m.award_date, m.awarded_amt ORDER BY max(w.total_amt) DESC, m.supplier_name, m.award_date

c74c1706167a6039.sql: -- R8: supplier name looks locally registered (PTE LTD / PRIVATE LIMITED / LLP...) but the Resolver found no ACRA -- entity above the confidence threshold. Names without a local suffix (foreign firms, government bodies, individuals) -- are labelled out_of_scope by the Resolver and are NOT flagged here ("outside registry scope"). -- Params: 'Housing and Development Board' '2024-04-01' '2025-03-31' SELECT 'R8' AS flag_id, a.tender_no, a.agency, a.supplier_name, x.uen AS uen, a.award_date, a.awarded_amt, 'resolver_confidence' AS metric_name, x.confidence AS metric_value, '0.8' AS threshold, concat('Anomaly for review: the supplier name "', a.supplier_name, '" looks locally registered but no ACRA entity matched above 0.8 (', CASE WHEN x.uen IS NULL THEN 'unresolved' ELSE concat('best match ', x.uen, ' via ', x.method) END, '). Closest candidate: ', coalesce(get_json_object(x.candidates, '$[0].entity_name'), 'none'), '. May be a renamed, mistyped or unregistered entity; requires auditor judgement.') AS detail FROM gebiz_pg.awards a JOIN gebiz_pg.supplier_xwalk x ON x.supplier_name = a.supplier_name WHERE a.agency = 'Housing and Development Board' AND a.award_date BETWEEN '2024-04-01' AND '2025-03-31' AND (x.method = 'unresolved' OR (x.uen IS NOT NULL AND x.confidence < 0.8)) ORDER BY a.awarded_amt DESC
